pre_run_business_contract: Start with accepted C03 two-aircraft shared-crew formation. One fixed 20-minute INSPECT preparation subtask per aircraft requires P-CREW with RPROB=1, and permits P-ALT as ARID. P-ALT capacity is two. Vary primary P-CREW capacity two versus zero and alternative time factor ARTF one versus two, without introducing stochastic need.

expected_native_hypothesis.primary-2-artf-2: primary P-CREW is selected and the 20-minute task duration is unaffected by ARTF
expected_native_hypothesis.primary-0-artf-1: alternative P-ALT is selected and the task lasts 20 minutes
expected_native_hypothesis.primary-0-artf-2: alternative P-ALT is selected and the task lasts 40 minutes

acceptance_requires: per-aircraft selected resource and task start/end timestamps
resource release, mission and terminal state
limitations: Only one alternative type and ARTF one or two are tested; multiple simultaneous alternatives and maximum-factor rule remain unverified.
RPROB remains one; probabilistic demand belongs to separate C06 variants.
The hypotheses are not accepted outcomes until native evidence and independent replay pass.
